items.textAr: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ﴿٢٥٥﴾
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa al-hayyul-qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm...
items.meaningEn: Allah — there is no god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قرأها حين يصبح أُجير من الشيطان حتى يمسي، ومن قرأها حين يمسي أُجير منه حتى يصبح.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever recites it in the morning is protected from Shaytan until evening, and whoever recites it in the evening is protected until morning.
items.sourceRef: Quran 2:255 — virtue: an-Nasa'i, as-Sunan al-Kubra 9928; al-Hakim 2064

items.textAr: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ ﴿٤﴾
items.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahad, Allahus-samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.
items.meaningEn: Surat al-Ikhlas: Say, He is Allah, the One; Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, and there is none comparable to Him.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن قراءة الإخلاص والمعوذتين ثلاث مرات حين يمسي وحين يصبح تكفي العبد من كل شيء.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that reciting al-Ikhlas and the two Mu'awwidhat three times in the evening and morning suffices a person against everything.

items.textAr: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq, min sharri ma khalaq, wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab, wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad, wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
items.meaningEn: Surat al-Falaq: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن قراءة الإخلاص والمعوذتين ثلاث مرات حين يمسي وحين يصبح تكفي العبد من كل شيء.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that reciting al-Ikhlas and the two Mu'awwidhat three times in the evening and morning suffices a person against everything.

items.textAr: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas, malikin-nas, ilahin-nas, min sharril-waswasil-khannas, alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas, minal-jinnati wan-nas.
items.meaningEn: Surat an-Nas: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers in the hearts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن قراءة الإخلاص والمعوذتين ثلاث مرات حين يمسي وحين يصبح تكفي العبد من كل شيء.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that reciting al-Ikhlas and the two Mu'awwidhat three times in the evening and morning suffices a person against everything.

items.textAr: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
items.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa khayra ma ba'dah, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhal-yawmi wa sharri ma ba'dah. Rabbi a'udhu bika minal-kasali wa su'il-kibar. Rabbi a'udhu bika min 'adhabin fin-nari wa 'adhabin fil-qabr.
items.meaningEn: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, and praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bi-ni'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u laka bi-dhanbi faghfir li, fa-innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قاله من النهار موقنًا به فمات من يومه قبل أن يمسي فهو من أهل الجنة، ومن قاله من الليل موقنًا به فمات قبل أن يصبح فهو من أهل الجنة.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever says it during the day with firm faith and dies that day before evening is among the people of Paradise, and likewise whoever says it at night and dies before morning.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahummastur 'awrati wa amin raw'ati. Allahummahfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa 'an yamini wa 'an shimali wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi-'azamatika an ughtala min tahti.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family and my wealth. O Allah, cover my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from before me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unawares from beneath me.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ لا يدع هذه الدعوات حين يمسي وحين يصبح.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ never left these supplications in the evening and the morning.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
items.transliteration: Allahumma 'alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shay'in wa malikah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, from the evil of Shaytan and his call to associate partners with You, and from committing wrong against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
items.virtueAr: أمر النبي ﷺ أن يقال إذا أصبح وإذا أمسى وإذا أخذ مضجعه.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ instructed that it be said in the morning, in the evening, and when going to bed.

items.textAr: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama', wa huwas-sami'ul-'alim.
items.meaningEn: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قالها ثلاث مرات لم يضره شيء.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever says it three times will not be harmed by anything.

items.textAr: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
items.transliteration: Ya hayyu ya qayyum, bi-rahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullah, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn.
items.meaningEn: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help: set right all my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
items.virtueAr: أوصى به النبي ﷺ فاطمة رضي الله عنها أن تقوله إذا أصبحت وإذا أمست.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ advised Fatimah to say it in the morning and the evening.

items.textAr: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا، وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
items.transliteration: Asbahna 'ala fitratil-islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini nabiyyina Muhammad ﷺ, wa 'ala millati abina Ibrahima hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin.
items.meaningEn: We have entered the morning upon the natural way of Islam, upon the word of pure sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, upright and submitting, and he was not of those who associate partners with Allah.

items.textAr: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih.
items.meaningEn: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قالها حين يصبح وحين يمسي مائة مرة لم يأت أحد يوم القيامة بأفضل مما جاء به إلا أحد قال مثل ما قال أو زاد عليه.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever says it a hundred times in the morning and evening, no one will come on the Day of Resurrection with anything better, except one who said the same or more.

items.textAr: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
items.meaningEn: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قالها في يوم مائة مرة كانت له عدل عشر رقاب، وكتبت له مائة حسنة، ومحيت عنه مائة سيئة، وكانت له حرزًا من الشيطان يومه ذلك حتى يمسي.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever says it a hundred times in a day receives the reward of freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are recorded for him, a hundred sins are erased, and it is a protection from Shaytan that day until evening.

items.textAr: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih, 'adada khalqih, wa rida nafsih, wa zinata 'arshih, wa midada kalimatih.
items.meaningEn: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, as many times as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as much as the weight of His Throne, and as much as the ink of His words.
items.virtueAr: قالها النبي ﷺ لجويرية رضي الله عنها بعد أن صلى الصبح، وأخبر أنها لو وزنت بما قالته منذ الصباح لوزنتها.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ taught these words to Juwayriyah after the Fajr prayer and said they would outweigh all she had said since dawn.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and deeds that are accepted.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ يقوله إذا صلى الصبح حين يسلم.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ used to say it after the Fajr prayer when he gave the salam.

items.textAr: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ﴿٢٥٥﴾
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa al-hayyul-qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm...
items.meaningEn: Allah — there is no god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قرأها حين يصبح أُجير من الشيطان حتى يمسي، ومن قرأها حين يمسي أُجير منه حتى يصبح.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever recites it in the morning is protected from Shaytan until evening, and whoever recites it in the evening is protected until morning.
items.sourceRef: Quran 2:255 — virtue: an-Nasa'i, as-Sunan al-Kubra 9928; al-Hakim 2064

items.textAr: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ﴿٢٨٥﴾ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ﴿٢٨٦﴾
items.transliteration: Amanar-rasulu bima unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu'minun... (2:285–286)
items.meaningEn: The final two verses of Surat al-Baqarah: the Messenger and the believers affirm faith in Allah, His angels, His books and His messengers, and ask Him for forgiveness, for no burden beyond their capacity, and for victory.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قرأ الآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلة كفتاه.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever recites the last two verses of Surat al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.
items.sourceRef: Quran 2:285–286 — virtue: Sahih al-Bukhari 5009; Sahih Muslim 808

items.textAr: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ ﴿٤﴾
items.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahad, Allahus-samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.
items.meaningEn: Surat al-Ikhlas: Say, He is Allah, the One; Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, and there is none comparable to Him.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن قراءة الإخلاص والمعوذتين ثلاث مرات حين يمسي وحين يصبح تكفي العبد من كل شيء.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that reciting al-Ikhlas and the two Mu'awwidhat three times in the evening and morning suffices a person against everything.

items.textAr: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq, min sharri ma khalaq, wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab, wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad, wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
items.meaningEn: Surat al-Falaq: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن قراءة الإخلاص والمعوذتين ثلاث مرات حين يمسي وحين يصبح تكفي العبد من كل شيء.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that reciting al-Ikhlas and the two Mu'awwidhat three times in the evening and morning suffices a person against everything.

items.textAr: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas, malikin-nas, ilahin-nas, min sharril-waswasil-khannas, alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas, minal-jinnati wan-nas.
items.meaningEn: Surat an-Nas: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers in the hearts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن قراءة الإخلاص والمعوذتين ثلاث مرات حين يمسي وحين يصبح تكفي العبد من كل شيء.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that reciting al-Ikhlas and the two Mu'awwidhat three times in the evening and morning suffices a person against everything.

items.textAr: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
items.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhihil-laylati wa khayra ma ba'daha, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhihil-laylati wa sharri ma ba'daha. Rabbi a'udhu bika minal-kasali wa su'il-kibar. Rabbi a'udhu bika min 'adhabin fin-nari wa 'adhabin fil-qabr.
items.meaningEn: We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah, and praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from punishment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bi-ni'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u laka bi-dhanbi faghfir li, fa-innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قاله من النهار موقنًا به فمات من يومه قبل أن يمسي فهو من أهل الجنة، ومن قاله من الليل موقنًا به فمات قبل أن يصبح فهو من أهل الجنة.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever says it during the day with firm faith and dies that day before evening is among the people of Paradise, and likewise whoever says it at night and dies before morning.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykal-masir.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahummastur 'awrati wa amin raw'ati. Allahummahfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa 'an yamini wa 'an shimali wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi-'azamatika an ughtala min tahti.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family and my wealth. O Allah, cover my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from before me and behind me, from my right and my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unawares from beneath me.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ لا يدع هذه الدعوات حين يمسي وحين يصبح.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ never left these supplications in the evening and the morning.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
items.transliteration: Allahumma 'alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shay'in wa malikah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, from the evil of Shaytan and his call to associate partners with You, and from committing wrong against myself or bringing it upon a Muslim.
items.virtueAr: أمر النبي ﷺ أن يقال إذا أصبح وإذا أمسى وإذا أخذ مضجعه.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ instructed that it be said in the morning, in the evening, and when going to bed.

items.textAr: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ، وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama', wa huwas-sami'ul-'alim.
items.meaningEn: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قالها ثلاث مرات لم يضره شيء.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever says it three times will not be harmed by anything.

items.textAr: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
items.transliteration: Ya hayyu ya qayyum, bi-rahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullah, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn.
items.meaningEn: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help: set right all my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
items.virtueAr: أوصى به النبي ﷺ فاطمة رضي الله عنها أن تقوله إذا أصبحت وإذا أمست.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ advised Fatimah to say it in the morning and the evening.

items.textAr: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا، وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
items.transliteration: Amsayna 'ala fitratil-islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini nabiyyina Muhammad ﷺ, wa 'ala millati abina Ibrahima hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin.
items.meaningEn: We have entered the evening upon the natural way of Islam, upon the word of pure sincerity, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, upright and submitting, and he was not of those who associate partners with Allah.

items.textAr: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bi-kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
items.meaningEn: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قالها حين يمسي لم تضره حُمَة تلك الليلة.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever says it in the evening will not be harmed by any sting that night.

items.textAr: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih.
items.meaningEn: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قالها حين يصبح وحين يمسي مائة مرة لم يأت أحد يوم القيامة بأفضل مما جاء به إلا أحد قال مثل ما قال أو زاد عليه.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever says it a hundred times in the morning and evening, no one will come on the Day of Resurrection with anything better, except one who said the same or more.

items.textAr: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
items.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.
items.meaningEn: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ يقوله إذا أخذ مضجعه من الليل.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ used to say it when he went to bed at night.

items.textAr: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ ﴿٤﴾ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
items.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahad... Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq... Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas...
items.meaningEn: Cup the hands, blow lightly into them and recite al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and an-Nas, then wipe over as much of the body as possible, starting with the head and face. Do this three times.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ يفعل ذلك كل ليلة إذا أوى إلى فراشه.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ did this every night when he went to bed.

items.textAr: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ﴿٢٥٥﴾
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa al-hayyul-qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm...
items.meaningEn: Ayat al-Kursi (Quran 2:255).
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قرأها إذا أوى إلى فراشه لم يزل عليه من الله حافظ، ولا يقربه شيطان حتى يصبح.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever recites it when going to bed will have a guardian from Allah, and no devil will come near him until morning.

items.textAr: ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ﴿٢٨٥﴾ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ﴿٢٨٦﴾
items.transliteration: Amanar-rasulu bima unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu'minun... (2:285–286)
items.meaningEn: The final two verses of Surat al-Baqarah: the Messenger and the believers affirm faith in Allah, His angels, His books and His messengers, and ask Him for forgiveness, for no burden beyond their capacity, and for victory.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قرأ الآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة في ليلة كفتاه.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever recites the last two verses of Surat al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.
items.sourceRef: Quran 2:285–286 — virtue: Sahih al-Bukhari 5009; Sahih Muslim 808

items.textAr: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Bismika rabbi wada'tu janbi, wa bika arfa'uh, in amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi 'ibadakas-salihin.
items.meaningEn: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy on it, and if You return it, protect it with that by which You protect Your righteous servants.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ إذا أراد أن يرقد وضع يده اليمنى تحت خده ثم قالها ثلاث مرات.
items.virtueEn: When the Prophet ﷺ wanted to sleep, he placed his right hand under his cheek and said it three times.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، اللَّهُمَّ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu wajhi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa alja'tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayk. Allahumma amantu bi-kitabikal-ladhi anzalt, wa bi-nabiyyikal-ladhi arsalt.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, I submit my face to You, entrust my affair to You, and rely on You for support, out of hope in You and fear of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. O Allah, I believe in Your Book which You revealed and in Your Prophet whom You sent.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قالها ثم مات من ليلته مات على الفطرة، وأن تُجعل آخر ما يتكلم به.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever says it and dies that night dies upon the fitrah; it should be the last thing one says before sleeping.

items.textAr: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لَا كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلَا مُؤْوِيَ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana, wa kafana wa awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wa la mu'wi.
items.meaningEn: Praise be to Allah who has fed us and given us drink, sufficed us and sheltered us; for how many are there who have no one to suffice them or give them shelter.

items.textAr: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallah.
items.meaningEn: Glory be to Allah.
items.virtueAr: علّمه النبي ﷺ عليًّا وفاطمة رضي الله عنهما عند النوم، وأخبر أنه خير لهما من خادم.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ taught it to Ali and Fatimah for bedtime and told them it was better for them than a servant.

items.textAr: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah.
items.meaningEn: Praise be to Allah.

items.textAr: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar.
items.meaningEn: Allah is the Greatest.

items.textAr: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.
items.meaningEn: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after He had caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ يقوله إذا استيقظ.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ used to say it when he woke up.

items.textAr: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Alhamdulillah, wa subhanallah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. Allahummaghfir li.
items.meaningEn: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. Praise be to Allah, glory be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power and no strength except through Allah. O Allah, forgive me.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من استيقظ من الليل فقال ذلك ثم دعا استجيب له، فإن توضأ وصلى قُبلت صلاته.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever wakes at night and says this and then supplicates is answered, and if he performs wudu and prays, his prayer is accepted.

items.textAr: إِنَّ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَـٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ ﴿١٩٠﴾ ٱلَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ قِيَـٰمًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَـٰذَا بَـٰطِلًا سُبْحَـٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ﴿١٩١﴾ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ ٱلنَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُۥ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ ﴿١٩٢﴾ رَّبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِى لِلْإِيمَـٰنِ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَـَٔامَنَّا ۚ رَبَّنَا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ ﴿١٩٣﴾ رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ ﴿١٩٤﴾ فَٱسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّى لَآ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَـٰمِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ ۖ بَعْضُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْضٍ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ وَأُخْرِجُوا۟ مِن دِيَـٰرِهِمْ وَأُوذُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِى وَقَـٰتَلُوا۟ وَقُتِلُوا۟ لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ثَوَابًا مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥ حُسْنُ ٱلثَّوَابِ ﴿١٩٥﴾ لَا يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ ﴿١٩٦﴾ مَتَـٰعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۚ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ ﴿١٩٧﴾ لَـٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلًا مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلْأَبْرَارِ ﴿١٩٨﴾ وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَـٰشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لَا يَشْتَرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا ۗ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ ﴿١٩٩﴾ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱصْبِرُوا۟ وَصَابِرُوا۟ وَرَابِطُوا۟ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ﴿٢٠٠﴾
items.meaningEn: The closing verses of Surat Al 'Imran (3:190–200), on reflecting upon the creation of the heavens and the earth and calling upon Allah.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ إذا قام من الليل قرأ هذه الآيات من آخر سورة آل عمران.
items.virtueEn: When the Prophet ﷺ got up at night, he recited these closing verses of Surat Al 'Imran.
items.sourceRef: Quran 3:190–200 — practice: Sahih al-Bukhari 4569; Sahih Muslim 763

items.textAr: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
items.transliteration: A'udhu billahil-'azim, wa bi-wajhihil-karim, wa sultanihil-qadim, minash-shaytanir-rajim.
items.meaningEn: I seek refuge in Allah the Almighty, in His noble Face and His eternal authority, from Shaytan the accursed. (On entering the mosque.)
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قاله عند دخول المسجد قال الشيطان: حُفظ مني سائر اليوم.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that when one says it on entering the mosque, Shaytan says: he is protected from me for the rest of the day.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy. (On entering the mosque.)

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty. (On leaving the mosque.)

items.textAr: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullah.
items.meaningEn: I seek the forgiveness of Allah.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ إذا انصرف من صلاته استغفر ثلاثًا.
items.virtueEn: When the Prophet ﷺ finished his prayer, he sought forgiveness three times.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma antas-salam, wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.

items.textAr: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayt, wa la mu'tiya lima mana't, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
items.meaningEn: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, none can give what You withhold, and the wealth of the wealthy cannot benefit him against You.

items.textAr: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ، وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. La ilaha illallah, wa la na'budu illa iyyah, lahun-ni'matu wa lahul-fadl, wa lahuth-thana'ul-hasan. La ilaha illallahu mukhlisina lahud-dina wa law karihal-kafirun.
items.meaningEn: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. There is no power and no strength except through Allah. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him. His is the blessing, His is the bounty, and His is the excellent praise. There is no god but Allah; we are sincere to Him in religion, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ يهلّل بهن دبر كل صلاة.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ used to say these words after every prayer.

items.textAr: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallah.
items.meaningEn: Glory be to Allah.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من سبّح الله دبر كل صلاة ثلاثًا وثلاثين، وحمده ثلاثًا وثلاثين، وكبّره ثلاثًا وثلاثين، وختم المائة بالتهليل، غُفرت خطاياه وإن كانت مثل زبد البحر.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever glorifies Allah 33 times after every prayer, praises Him 33 times, magnifies Him 33 times, and completes the hundred with the tahlil, his sins are forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.

items.textAr: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah.
items.meaningEn: Praise be to Allah.

items.textAr: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar.
items.meaningEn: Allah is the Greatest.

items.textAr: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
items.meaningEn: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. (Completing the hundred.)

items.textAr: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ﴿٢٥٥﴾
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa al-hayyul-qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm...
items.meaningEn: Ayat al-Kursi (Quran 2:255).
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قرأها دبر كل صلاة مكتوبة لم يمنعه من دخول الجنة إلا أن يموت.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that nothing stands between whoever recites it after every obligatory prayer and entering Paradise except death.

items.textAr: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ﴿١﴾ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ﴿٢﴾ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ﴿٣﴾ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ ﴿٤﴾ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ﴿١﴾ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ﴿٢﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ﴿٣﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّـٰثَـٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ ﴿٤﴾ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ ﴿٥﴾ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿١﴾ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٢﴾ إِلَـٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٣﴾ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ﴿٤﴾ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٥﴾ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ ﴿٦﴾
items.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahad... Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq... Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas...
items.meaningEn: Recite al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and an-Nas after each prayer.
items.virtueAr: أمر النبي ﷺ عقبة بن عامر رضي الله عنه أن يقرأ المعوذات دبر كل صلاة.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ instructed 'Uqbah ibn 'Amir to recite the Mu'awwidhat after every prayer.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni 'ibadatik.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best manner.
items.virtueAr: أوصى النبي ﷺ معاذ بن جبل رضي الله عنه ألا يدع قولها دبر كل صلاة.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ advised Mu'adh ibn Jabal never to leave saying it after every prayer.

items.textAr: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallah.
items.meaningEn: Glory be to Allah.
items.virtueAr: من أحب الكلام إلى الله: سبحان الله، والحمد لله، ولا إله إلا الله، والله أكبر.
items.virtueEn: Among the words most beloved to Allah are: Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illallah, and Allahu akbar.

items.textAr: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah.
items.meaningEn: Praise be to Allah.

items.textAr: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallah.
items.meaningEn: There is no god but Allah.

items.textAr: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar.
items.meaningEn: Allah is the Greatest.

items.textAr: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih, subhanallahil-'azim.
items.meaningEn: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him; glory be to Allah, the Almighty.
items.virtueAr: كلمتان خفيفتان على اللسان، ثقيلتان في الميزان، حبيبتان إلى الرحمن.
items.virtueEn: Two phrases light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful.

items.textAr: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
items.meaningEn: There is no power and no strength except through Allah.
items.virtueAr: كنز من كنوز الجنة.
items.virtueEn: A treasure from the treasures of Paradise.

items.textAr: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
items.transliteration: Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar.
items.meaningEn: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
items.virtueAr: أحب إلى النبي ﷺ مما طلعت عليه الشمس.
items.virtueEn: Dearer to the Prophet ﷺ than everything the sun rises upon.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bi-ni'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u laka bi-dhanbi faghfir li, fa-innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قاله من النهار موقنًا به فمات من يومه قبل أن يمسي فهو من أهل الجنة، ومن قاله من الليل موقنًا به فمات قبل أن يصبح فهو من أهل الجنة.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever says it during the day with firm faith and dies that day before evening is among the people of Paradise, and likewise whoever says it at night and dies before morning.

items.textAr: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh.
items.meaningEn: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and I repent to Him.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ يستغفر الله ويتوب إليه في اليوم أكثر من سبعين مرة، وفي رواية: مائة مرة.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ sought Allah's forgiveness and repented to Him more than seventy times a day; in another narration, a hundred times.

items.textAr: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa tub 'alayya, innaka antat-tawwabur-rahim.
items.meaningEn: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; indeed You are the Accepter of repentance, the Most Merciful.
items.virtueAr: كان يُعدّ للنبي ﷺ في المجلس الواحد مائة مرة.
items.virtueEn: It was counted that the Prophet ﷺ said it a hundred times in a single sitting.

items.textAr: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullahal-ladhi la ilaha illa huwal-hayyal-qayyuma wa atubu ilayh.
items.meaningEn: I seek the forgiveness of Allah, there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قاله غُفر له وإن كان فرّ من الزحف.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever says it is forgiven, even if he had fled from the battlefield.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، وَارْحَمْنِي، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran, wa la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant, faghfir li maghfiratan min 'indik, warhamni, innaka antal-ghafurur-rahim.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, I have greatly wronged myself, and none forgives sins but You, so grant me forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy on me; indeed You are the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
items.virtueAr: علّمه النبي ﷺ أبا بكر الصديق رضي الله عنه ليدعو به في صلاته.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ taught it to Abu Bakr as-Siddiq to supplicate with in his prayer.

items.textAr: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ﴿٢٠١﴾
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
items.meaningEn: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
items.virtueAr: كان أكثر دعاء النبي ﷺ.
items.virtueEn: It was the supplication the Prophet ﷺ made most often.
items.sourceRef: Quran 2:201 — practice: Sahih al-Bukhari 6389; Sahih Muslim 2690

items.textAr: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ ﴿٨﴾
items.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-wahhab.
items.meaningEn: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself; indeed You are the Bestower.

items.textAr: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
items.transliteration: Ya muqallibal-qulub, thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik.
items.meaningEn: O Turner of hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.
items.virtueAr: كان أكثر ما يدعو به النبي ﷺ.
items.virtueEn: It was among the supplications the Prophet ﷺ made most often.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى، وَالتُّقَى، وَالْعَفَافَ، وَالْغِنَى
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda, wat-tuqa, wal-'afafa, wal-ghina.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
items.transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, You are Pardoning and You love to pardon, so pardon me.
items.virtueAr: علّمه النبي ﷺ عائشة رضي الله عنها لتدعو به إن وافقت ليلة القدر.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ taught it to 'A'ishah to say if she found Laylat al-Qadr.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِيَ الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي، وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
items.transliteration: Allahumma aslih li diniyal-ladhi huwa 'ismatu amri, wa aslih li dunyayal-lati fiha ma'ashi, wa aslih li akhiratil-lati fiha ma'adi, waj'alil-hayata ziyadatan li fi kulli khayr, waj'alil-mawta rahatan li min kulli sharr.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, set right for me my religion, which is the safeguard of my affairs; set right for me my worldly life, in which is my livelihood; set right for me my Hereafter, to which is my return. Make life an increase for me in every good, and make death a relief for me from every evil.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min zawali ni'matik, wa tahawwuli 'afiyatik, wa fuja'ati niqmatik, wa jami'i sakhatik.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the loss of Your blessings, the removal of the well-being You granted, the suddenness of Your punishment, and all that displeases You.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayn, wa ghalabatir-rijal.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ يكثر أن يدعو به.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ used to say it often.

items.textAr: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-'azimul-halim, la ilaha illallahu rabbul-'arshil-'azim, la ilaha illallahu rabbus-samawati wa rabbul-ardi wa rabbul-'arshil-karim.
items.meaningEn: There is no god but Allah, the Almighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ يقوله عند الكرب.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ used to say it in times of distress.

items.textAr: لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ﴿٨٧﴾
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
items.meaningEn: There is no god but You; glory be to You. Indeed, I have been among the wrongdoers.
items.virtueAr: دعوة ذي النون، ورد أنه لم يدع بها مسلم في شيء قط إلا استجاب الله له.
items.virtueEn: The supplication of Dhun-Nun (Yunus). It is reported that no Muslim calls upon Allah with it for anything except that Allah answers him.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju, fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn, wa aslih li sha'ni kullah, la ilaha illa ant.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye, and set right all my affairs. There is no god but You.
items.virtueAr: من دعوات المكروب.
items.virtueEn: One of the supplications for a person in distress.

items.textAr: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئًا
items.transliteration: Allahu Allahu rabbi la ushriku bihi shay'a.
items.meaningEn: Allah, Allah is my Lord; I do not associate anything with Him.
items.virtueAr: علّمه النبي ﷺ أسماء بنت عميس رضي الله عنها لتقوله عند الكرب.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ taught it to Asma' bint 'Umays to say in times of distress.

items.textAr: حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ ﴿١٧٣﴾
items.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil.
items.meaningEn: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
items.virtueAr: قالها إبراهيم عليه السلام حين أُلقي في النار، وقالها محمد ﷺ حين قيل له إن الناس قد جمعوا لكم.
items.virtueEn: Ibrahim said it when he was thrown into the fire, and Muhammad ﷺ said it when told that the people had gathered against them.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni 'abduk, ibnu 'abdik, ibnu amatik, nasiyati biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, 'adlun fiyya qada'uk. As'aluka bi-kulli ismin huwa lak, sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fi kitabik, aw 'allamtahu ahadan min khalqik, awista'tharta bihi fi 'ilmil-ghaybi 'indak, an taj'alal-Qur'ana rabi'a qalbi, wa nura sadri, wa jala'a huzni, wa dhahaba hammi.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand, Your judgment over me is carried out, and Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours, with which You named Yourself, or revealed in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept with Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen, to make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the removal of my sorrow, and the departure of my worry.
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قاله أذهب الله همه وحزنه وأبدله مكانه فرجًا.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever says it, Allah removes his worry and grief and replaces it with relief.

items.textAr: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا، وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
items.transliteration: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar. Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun. Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha, watwi 'anna bu'dah. Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar, wal-khalifatu fil-ahl. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safar, wa ka'abatil-manzar, wa su'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl.
items.meaningEn: Allah is the Greatest (three times). Glory be to the One who has subjected this to us, for we could not have done so ourselves, and to our Lord we shall return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance for us. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian of the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardships of travel, from a distressing sight, and from an evil outcome in wealth and family.
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ يقوله إذا استوى على بعيره خارجًا إلى سفر.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ used to say it when he mounted his camel to set out on a journey.

items.textAr: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
items.transliteration: Ayibuna, ta'ibuna, 'abiduna, li-rabbina hamidun.
items.meaningEn: We return, repentant, worshipping, and praising our Lord. (On returning from a journey.)
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ يزيد هذا إذا رجع من سفره.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ added these words when returning from a journey.

items.textAr: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bi-kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
items.meaningEn: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created. (On stopping at a place.)
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من نزل منزلًا ثم قالها لم يضره شيء حتى يرتحل من منزله ذلك.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever stops at a place and says it will not be harmed by anything until he departs from it.

items.textAr: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah.
items.meaningEn: In the name of Allah. (Before eating.)
items.virtueAr: أمر النبي ﷺ بالتسمية والأكل باليمين ومما يلي الآكل.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ instructed to mention Allah's name, eat with the right hand, and eat from what is nearest.

items.textAr: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirah.
items.meaningEn: In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end. (If one forgot to say Bismillah at the start.)

items.textAr: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha, wa razaqanihi, min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
items.meaningEn: Praise be to Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any power or strength on my part. (After eating.)
items.virtueAr: ورد أن من قاله بعد الطعام غُفر له ما تقدم من ذنبه.
items.virtueEn: It is reported that whoever says it after eating has his past sins forgiven.

items.textAr: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih, ghayra makfiyyin wa la muwadda'in wa la mustaghnan 'anhu rabbana.
items.meaningEn: Praise be to Allah, abundant, good and blessed praise, praise that is never sufficient, never abandoned, and never dispensed with, our Lord. (After eating.)
items.virtueAr: كان النبي ﷺ يقوله إذا رُفعت مائدته.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ used to say it when his table was cleared.

items.textAr: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ، وَارْحَمْهُمْ
items.transliteration: Allahumma barik lahum fima razaqtahum, waghfir lahum, warhamhum.
items.meaningEn: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided for them, forgive them, and have mercy on them. (For the host.)
items.virtueAr: دعا به النبي ﷺ لمن أطعمه.
items.virtueEn: The Prophet ﷺ supplicated with it for those who hosted him for a meal.
